A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

About AaloApp

Clear answers for families and schools.

Ask another question
What is AaloApp?+

AaloApp is an affordable, curriculum-aligned AI tutoring app from AaloPro for primary and secondary students. It provides step-by-step learning support on a phone and is designed to work offline.

Which Bangladesh curricula is AaloApp built for?+

AaloApp Bangla Primary is built for the Bangladesh primary school curriculum. AaloApp Bangla Secondary is built for the Bangladesh secondary school curriculum.

What does AaloApp SG Primary cover?+

AaloApp SG Primary is built for Singapore primary school students, with a focus on learning Chinese, English and maths.

Does AaloApp work offline?+

AaloApp is designed for offline learning. For details about initial setup, content downloads and device compatibility, contact AaloPro before choosing an edition.

How much does AaloApp cost?+

The listed AaloApp price is US$1 per month for primary students and US$2 per month for secondary students. Contact AaloPro to confirm the edition that fits your school or child.

Can I download AaloApp now?+

Public app store links are not ready yet. Explore the AaloApp editions on this page, or email help@aalopro.com for product and school enquiries.
